bio: Blake Daughtrey is a drum corps visual designer and educator whose performing career began with Carolina Crown (2005-2010) as a mellophone player and drum major. He joined the Madison Scouts visual staff in 2012 and served as visual Caption Head from 2013-2016, then led the visual program at the Crossmen from 2017-2020 as a full-time designer and choreographer. Daughtrey returned to the Madison Scouts as Visual Caption Supervisor for the 2026 season.

Ian Grom is a percussion arranger, composer and designer who received his Bachelor of Music in Percussion Performance from California State University, Long Beach. In drum corps he worked with The Cadets as an electronics consultant and arranger from 2009-2012 and joined the Blue Stars design team as front ensemble and co-brass arranger from 2013-2016. Grom co-founded Box Six, a publisher of original percussion and marching band material, with fellow designer John Mapes, and teaches the Chino Hills High School percussion ensemble.

Ivan De La Cruz is a full-time visual designer based out of Fort Worth, Texas, who serves on the visual staff of Phantom Regiment. His clients span Texas, Mississippi, Ohio, Arizona and New Mexico, and he works nationally as a marching band adjudicator, consultant and clinician. De La Cruz also served as Corps Director for the Santa Clara Vanguard organization (overseeing the Vanguard and Vanguard Cadets) from 2019-2021.

Jeremy Figlewicz is a brass educator who has taught on the brass staffs of several drum corps. He served on the brass staff of Phantom Regiment (appearing in DCI yearbooks around 2010 and 2012) and has been part of The Cavaliers' brass educational team, including their 2018 and 2019 seasons. Figlewicz has also worked as a brass instructor with Pacific Crest.

Joe Woodie is a battery percussion instructor who marched with the Bluecoats Drum and Bugle Corps and now serves as a battery instructor for the ensemble, including the staff that guided the Bluecoats to the 2016 DCI World Class Championship. He also marched with and instructs the Rhythm X indoor percussion ensemble. A graduate of Bowling Green State University with a bachelor's degree in music, Woodie works as the percussion specialist at William Mason High School in Ohio.

John Mapes is a full-time percussion educator, arranger and designer based in Southern California who earned his degree in percussion from California State University, Long Beach in 2000. In drum corps he was the battery arranger for the Blue Stars from 2013-2016 and the percussion arranger for the Blue Devils B Corps from 2007-2012, and he joined the Sacramento Mandarins design team as battery arranger in 2025. Mapes has been Percussion Director at Chino Hills High School since 2005 and is a Vic Firth, Yamaha, Remo and Zildjian artist with dozens of WGI medals.
